svg.title: Miryoku-inspired Chocofi layer overview
svg.desc: Six keyboard diagrams showing the base, navigation, mouse, media, symbol, and number layers for a 36-key Chocofi layout.

g.text: Volume, RGB, playback, and Hyper arrows
Symbols plus a right-hand mod cluster
Numbers, brackets, and a right-hand mod cluster

svg.text: Empty caps inherit from the base layer. Omitted matrix slots are not physical keys on the 36-key Chocofi.
